claims.sourceQuote: The Medical College/Institution/University shall take strict action against those found guilty of ragging and/or of abetting ragging.

claims.scope: Government-quota MD/MS/Diploma prospectus — Annexure IV anti-ragging directions
claims.claim: Admission advertisements must state that ragging is totally banned/prohibited and that offenders are liable to punishment.
claims.sourceQuote: The advertisement for admissions shall clearly mention that ragging is totally banned / prohibited ... and anyone found guilty ... is liable to be punished appropriately.

claims.scope: Government-quota MD/MS/Diploma prospectus — Annexure IV anti-ragging directions
claims.claim: The prospectus/admission booklet must print the regulations in block letters.
claims.sourceQuote: The brochure of admission/instruction booklet for candidates shall print in block letters these Regulations in full (including Annexures).

claims.scope: Government-quota MD/MS/Diploma prospectus — Annexure IV anti-ragging directions
claims.claim: Prospectus/admission-related documents must incorporate applicable Supreme Court and Government directions and sensitize candidates and parents/guardians to the prohibition and consequences.
claims.sourceQuote: The “Prospectus” and other admission related documents shall incorporate all directions ... so that the candidates and their parents/ guardians are sensitized in respect of the prohibition and consequences of ragging.

claims.scope: Government-quota MD/MS/Diploma prospectus — Annexure IV anti-ragging directions
claims.claim: The candidate undertaking must be printed, preferably in English/Hindi and a regional language, and acknowledge the law, punishments and no prior expulsion/debarment.
claims.sourceQuote: The application form for admission/enrolment shall have a printed undertaking, preferably both in English/Hindi and in one of the regional languages ... the candidate ... is aware of the law ... punishments ... and ... has not been expelled and/or debarred from admission by any institution.

claims.scope: Government-quota MD/MS/Diploma prospectus — Annexure IV anti-ragging directions
claims.claim: A parent/guardian signs a separate undertaking acknowledging the law and agreeing to abide by punishment imposed on the ward.
claims.sourceQuote: The application form shall also contain a printed undertaking ... to be signed by the parent/ guardian ... aware of the law ... and agrees to abide by the punishment meted out to his/her ward.

claims.scope: Government-quota MD/MS/Diploma prospectus — Annexure IV anti-ragging directions
claims.claim: An electronic database must store student and parent/guardian affidavits and record ragging complaints.
claims.sourceQuote: A database shall be created out of affidavits affirmed by each student and his/her parents/guardians stored electronically ... The database shall also function as a record of ragging complaints received.

claims.scope: Government-quota MD/MS/Diploma prospectus — Annexure IV anti-ragging directions
claims.claim: The admission application must include a School Leaving/Transfer/Migration/Character Certificate with a behavioural-pattern report.
claims.sourceQuote: The application for admission shall be accompanied by a document in the form of the School Leaving Certificate/transfer certificate/migration certificate/ Character Certificate which shall include a report on the behavioral pattern of the applicant.

claims.scope: Government-quota MD/MS/Diploma prospectus — Annexure IV anti-ragging directions
claims.claim: Hostel applicants must submit the additional undertaking in both parts with the hostel accommodation application.
claims.sourceQuote: A student seeking admission to the hostel shall have to submit additional undertaking in the form of Annexure I (both Parts) along with his/her application for hostel accommodation.

claims.scope: Government-quota MD/MS/Diploma prospectus — Annexure IV anti-ragging directions
claims.claim: At the start of the academic session, the Head of Institution convenes wardens, students, parents/guardians, faculty, district administration and police to discuss prevention and response.
claims.sourceQuote: At the commencement of the academic session the Head of the Institution shall convene and address a meeting ... Wardens, representatives of students, parents/guardians, faculty, district administration including police, to discuss the measures to be taken to prevent ragging.

claims.scope: Government-quota MD/MS/Diploma prospectus — Annexure IV anti-ragging directions
claims.claim: Institutions must display anti-ragging posters prominently in departments, hostels and vulnerable places.
claims.sourceQuote: big posters ... shall be prominently displayed on all Notice Boards of all departments, hostels & other buildings as well as at vulnerable places.

claims.scope: Government-quota MD/MS/Diploma prospectus — Annexure IV anti-ragging directions
claims.claim: Institutions should use audiovisual aids, counselling, workshops and student activities to prevent ragging.
claims.sourceQuote: The Medical College/Institution shall undertake measures for extensive publicity against ragging by means of audio-visual aids, by holding counseling sessions, workshops, painting and design competitions among students.

claims.scope: Government-quota MD/MS/Diploma prospectus — Annexure IV anti-ragging directions
claims.claim: Institutions should seek media publicity for the law and punishment of offenders.
claims.sourceQuote: The Medical College/Institution/University shall request the media to give adequate publicity to the law prohibiting ragging and the negative aspects of ragging.

claims.scope: Government-quota MD/MS/Diploma prospectus — Annexure IV anti-ragging directions
claims.claim: Institutions must identify, illuminate and secure vulnerable locations and may use intensive police patrolling when needed.
claims.sourceQuote: The Medical College/Institution/University shall identify, properly illuminate and man all vulnerable locations. ... tighten security ... If necessary, intensive policing shall be resorted to at such points at odd hours.

claims.scope: Government-quota MD/MS/Diploma prospectus — Annexure IV anti-ragging directions
claims.claim: Institutions should use vacation periods for anti-ragging publicity campaigns.
claims.sourceQuote: The Medical College/Institution/University shall utilize the vacation period before the start of the new academic year to launch wide publicity campaign against ragging.

claims.scope: Government-quota MD/MS/Diploma prospectus — Annexure IV anti-ragging directions
claims.claim: Institutions must arrange student induction and obtain staff undertakings to report ragging.
claims.sourceQuote: The faculties/departments/units ... shall have induction arrangements ... The Principal ... shall obtain an undertaking from every employee ... that he/she would report promptly any case of ragging.

claims.scope: Government-quota MD/MS/Diploma prospectus — Annexure IV anti-ragging directions
claims.claim: Freshers must receive a leaflet naming help contacts, authorities, addresses and telephone numbers.
claims.sourceQuote: Every fresher admitted ... shall be given a printed leaflet ... including Wardens, Head of the institution, members of the anti-ragging committees, relevant district and police authorities, addresses and telephone numbers.

claims.scope: Government-quota MD/MS/Diploma prospectus — Annexure IV anti-ragging directions
claims.claim: Institutions should provide professional counsellors to help freshers adjust, particularly in hostels.
claims.sourceQuote: Every institution should engage or seek the assistance of professional counselors at the time of admissions to counsel freshers in order to prepare them for the life ahead, particularly for adjusting to the life in hostels.

claims.scope: Government-quota MD/MS/Diploma prospectus — Annexure IV anti-ragging directions
claims.claim: The leaflet should explain fresher rights, reporting routes and a calendar of orientation events.
claims.sourceQuote: The leaflet ... shall also inform the freshers about their rights ... shall contain a calendar of events and activities laid down by the institution.

claims.scope: Government-quota MD/MS/Diploma prospectus — Annexure IV anti-ragging directions
claims.claim: Institutions should jointly sensitize freshers and seniors and schedule further orientation after seniors arrive in the first or second week.
claims.sourceQuote: The Medical College/Institution/University shall also organize joint sensitization programmes of “freshers” and seniors. On the arrival of senior students after the first week or after the second week ... further orientation programmes must be scheduled.

claims.scope: Government-quota MD/MS/Diploma prospectus — Annexure IV anti-ragging directions
claims.claim: Freshers should be encouraged to report incidents as victims or witnesses.
claims.sourceQuote: Freshers shall be encouraged to report incidents of ragging, either as victims, or even as witnesses.

claims.scope: Government-quota MD/MS/Diploma prospectus — Annexure IV anti-ragging directions
claims.claim: At year end, the Dean/Principal/Director sends first-year students’ parents/guardians a letter about the law and penalties.
claims.sourceQuote: At the end of every academic year the Dean/Principal/Director shall send a letter to the parents/guardians of the students who are completing the first year informing them about the law regarding ragging and the punishments.

claims.scope: Government-quota MD/MS/Diploma prospectus — Annexure IV anti-ragging directions
claims.claim: The mentoring cell provides one mentor per six freshers and one higher-level mentor per six lower-level mentors.
claims.sourceQuote: at the rate of 1 Mentor for 6 freshers and 1 Mentor of a higher level for 6 Mentors of the lower level.

claims.scope: Government-quota MD/MS/Diploma prospectus — Annexure IV anti-ragging directions
claims.claim: Mentors should interact with each fresher group daily and address problems.
claims.sourceQuote: Such staff member should interact individually with each member of the group on a daily 6 basis for ascertaining the problems/difficulties if any faced by the fresher.

claims.scope: Government-quota MD/MS/Diploma prospectus — Annexure IV anti-ragging directions
claims.claim: For hostel freshers, the group teacher coordinates with the warden and makes surprise room visits.
claims.sourceQuote: the teacher in charge of the group to coordinate with the warden of the hostel and to make surprise visits to the rooms in the hostel.

claims.scope: Government-quota MD/MS/Diploma prospectus — Annexure IV anti-ragging directions
claims.claim: The main prospectus says candidates who engage in agitation, strike or ragging will be expelled at any stage and criminal action will be taken.
claims.sourceQuote: Candidates who join Post Graduate Degree / Diploma Courses should not indulge in any kind of agitation, strike or ragging activity inside and outside the college campus ... will be expelled ... and criminal action will be taken.

claims.scope: Government-quota MD/MS/Diploma prospectus — Annexure IV anti-ragging directions
claims.claim: The main text cites an MCI direction dated 11th September 2014, while the attached notification is headed 3rd August 2009.
claims.sourceQuote: MCI ... dated 11.09.2014 ... Annexure IV. … MCI Notification ... New Delhi, the 3rd August, 2009.
claims.reason: The prospectus cites a 2014 direction but the reproduced notification is headed 2009; the source does not reconcile the references.
claims.suggestedCorrection: Keep both printed dates and confirm the operative reference with the Selection Committee.

claims.scope: Government-quota MD/MS/Diploma prospectus — Annexure IV anti-ragging directions
claims.claim: GQ MD/MS/Diploma Annexure IV is an MCI notification dated 3rd August 2009, No. MCI-34(1)/2009-Med./25453.
claims.sourceQuote: MEDICAL COUNCIL OF INDIA NOTIFICATION New Delhi, the 3rd August, 2009 No. MCI-34(1)/2009-Med./25453
